props.gloss_en: Hillel: if I am here, all is here; and if I am not here, who is here
Hillel: to the place that I love, there my feet lead me
Hillel: if you come to my house, I will come to your house; if you do not come to my house, I will not come to your house
as it is said: 'in every place where I cause My name to be mentioned I will come to you and bless you' (Ex 20:21)
he too saw a skull floating on the water and said to it: because you drowned, they drowned you, and those who drowned you will be drowned
R' Yochanan: a man's feet are his guarantors; to the place where he is wanted, there they bring him
those two Cushites who stood before Solomon, Elichoref and Achiya sons of Shisha, were Solomon's scribes
[Solomon:] why are you sad? He said to him: because they ask of me these two Cushites who sit here
he handed them to the se'irim, who sent them to the district of Luz; when they reached the district of Luz they died
[Solomon:] why are you glad? He said to him: to the place where they asked them of me, there you sent them
at once Solomon opened and said: a man's feet are his guarantors; to the place where he is wanted, there they bring him
rejoicing, he would take eight torches of light, throw one and take one, and they did not touch one another
and when he prostrated himself he set his two thumbs in the earth, bowed, kissed the floor and straightened -- and no creature can do so
and this is kidda
Levi demonstrated kidda before Rebbi and was dislocated [lamed] -- the kidda is what caused it
R' Elazar: let a man never speak impertinently upward
for a great man spoke impertinently upward and was dislocated -- and who was he? Levi
[stam:] this and that [both] caused it
Levi would juggle before Rebbi with eight knives
Shmuel before King Shapur with eight cups of wine
Abaye before (Rabba) with eight eggs
and some say: with four eggs
R' Yehoshua ben Chananya: when we rejoiced at the Simchat Beit HaShoeva we saw no sleep in our eyes

how so? the first hour, the morning tamid; thence to prayer; thence to the musaf offering; thence to the musaf prayer; thence to the beit midrash; thence to eating and drinking; thence to the mincha prayer; thence to the afternoon tamid; from then on to the Simchat Beit HaShoeva
R' Yochanan: '[I take] an oath that I will not sleep three days' -- he is flogged and sleeps at once
[stam:] rather, this is what he says: we did not taste the taste of sleep, for they would doze on one another's shoulders

objections.gloss_en: והא גרמא ליה? והאמר רבי אלעזר... ואיטלע, ומנו לוי -- was it the kidda that caused it? R' Elazar assigns Levi's dislocation to his impertinent speech (kind svara under protest: the והאמר memra-contradiction has no kind, §12)
